# OD HarmoTools

> A practical workspace for exploring musical harmony: scales, chords, keys, circle of fifths, random and chord sequencers, MIDI export, pitch CV conversions, a reference tone generator, a digital metronome, and audio and spectrum analysis. DonationWare — the full version is available for unrestricted use.

## Introduction

OD HarmoTools is a music software landing page and downloadable application by Olivier Dahan. The workspace makes scales, chords and keys immediately playable, visible and connected. The full version supports audio playback, keyboard and MIDI input, and exports chord progressions and sequences as Standard MIDI Files (format 0) for use in a DAW. Memories and sequences can also be dragged directly into Bitwig or Ableton Live without going through a temporary MIDI file on disk.

## Key features

- [Scales & chords](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): choose a root and a mode to see notes, diatonic chords and keyboard voicings
- [Scale finder](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): select notes and let the app reveal candidate scales
- [Chord name & chord finder](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): enter or play a chord to inspect its notes, inversions and spellings
- [Circle of fifths](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): key signatures, relative minors and chord-progression building
- [Frequencies & volts](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): convert notes, frequencies and pitch control voltages with Hz/V or V/Oct settings, adjustable C4 voltage and A4 tuning reference
- [Reference tone](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): waveform and volume controls for tuning a synthesizer or VCO by ear
- [Instrument ranges](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): frequency ranges and instrumental tessituras
- [Digital metronome](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): BPM and Tap Tempo, visual pulse, beat accents, sound and volume
- [Memories](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): favourite scales and saved chord progressions
- [Random & chord sequencers](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): 4–64 step patterns, up to six saved sequences, MIDI export
- [Direct MIDI drag and drop](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): transfer memories and sequences directly into Bitwig or Ableton Live without a temporary MIDI file on disk
- [Audio analyzer · Pitch detection](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): analyze one note at a time from a microphone, USB microphone or ASIO audio interface; display the measured frequency, note name and tuning offset in cents from the nearest in-tune note using an adjustable A4 reference
- [Audio analyzer · Spectrum](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): view the spectrum in Hz and dBFS, identify the detected fundamental and harmonic peaks, and freeze a stable measurement
- [Audio settings, MIDI & diagnostics](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): SoundFont, audio output, MIDI input
- [Built-in guide](https://www.e-naxos.com/HarmoTools/): user manual shipped with the application

## Scale library

52 public scale definitions, including 48 recognition candidates: major, harmonic and melodic minor modes, pentatonic, whole tone, octatonic, augmented, blues, bebop, harmonic major, Hungarian minor, Neapolitan, Persian, Arabic, Japanese (Hirajoshi, Insen, Iwato, Yo, Kumoi) and more.
